items.difficulty_reason: The lemma compares the associated graded modules of the two cokernels appearing in the Artin-Rees perturbation statement, and the proof is a 19-line argument that proves one inclusion between the two filtered pieces and then invokes symmetry. The inclusion is checked by writing an element of the intersection as g(a) with a controlled valuation, subtracting the corresponding element for g', and using the hypothesis that the two maps agree modulo the higher power of the ideal. The valuation bookkeeping is where the content lies, and the author displays both the claim and the symmetry argument.
